exceptions.rationale: ESLint 9/minimatch 3 requires the brace-expansion 1.x CommonJS API, so the 1.x and 5.x brace-expansion lines are kept line-compatible but advanced to their current patched floors (1.1.21 and 5.0.12). The remaining GHSA-VFJ7-8CJW-P6XM advisory is in braces <=3.0.3, currently has no patched npm release, and is tolerated only when npm audit reports the entire chain as dev-only. scripts/audit-security.mjs fails closed for production/runtime paths, critical findings, unknown advisories, expired exceptions, or brace-expansion floors below policy.
